additional_info.subject: RE: ID0371367-DC/Si-D/FR-[WPjRnU] Failsafe mode CRM:01811000193
additional_info.body:
Hello Yacine,
I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to inform you that the charger is currently in failsafe mode because of the coap polling error and problem you are experiencing will be resolved once the new firmware version v5.0.5 is released.
Our engineering team is working on solution to permanently fix this issue and the expected time is approximately one month.
If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
